# Everlasting Destiny

> The site of Frank Reyes (ZCapitan), spiritual teacher, author of The Book of Everlasting Destiny and creator of the ZCapitan YouTube channel, which shares guided meditations plus Shorts on the chakras, starseeds and the angelic orders.

## Pages

- [Home](https://everlastingdestiny.com/): Overview of the book, the channel, The Hallway and the F.A.R. music project
- [Books](https://everlastingdestiny.com/books.html): The Book of Everlasting Destiny by Frank Reyes, thirteen chapters distilled from letters he wrote to the people he loves
- [Watch](https://everlastingdestiny.com/watch.html): Guided meditations and Shorts from the ZCapitan YouTube channel
- [Listen](https://everlastingdestiny.com/listen.html): F.A.R. music by Frank Reyes. We Were Made of Dawn is out now, Unlocked is a single, and Into the Tide of Light is out now
- [The Hallway](https://everlastingdestiny.com/destiny-app.html): A daily companion app to The Book of Everlasting Destiny, coming soon
- [About](https://everlastingdestiny.com/about.html): About Frank Reyes and ZCapitan

## Book

- [The Book of Everlasting Destiny, Kindle edition on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GX2WRFKX): Kindle ebook, ASIN B0GX2WRFKX
